sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选访谈，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Texas has become the latest hotspot in the pandemic, forcing its governor to pause the state's reopening process after a surge of infections and hospitalizations.
sentences.zh: 今天，德克萨斯州已成为这场疫情的最新热点，由于感染人数和住院人数激增，该州州长被迫暂停了重启进程。

sentences.en: My colleague, Manny Fernandez, on The State's Dilemma.
sentences.zh: 我的同事曼尼·费尔南德斯将带来关于“该州的困境”的报道。

sentences.en: It's Friday, June 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月26日，星期五。

sentences.en: Manny, what is the story of how Texas has handled the pandemic and how it is we got to this point?
sentences.zh: 曼尼，德克萨斯州应对疫情的来龙去脉是怎样的？我们又是如何走到这一步的？

sentences.en: So, really, there's a couple things to know about Texas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，关于德克萨斯州有几点需要了解。

sentences.en: And that is that, historically, Texas has been mistrustful of government.
sentences.zh: 那就是，从历史上看，德克萨斯州一直对政府抱有不信任感。

sentences.en: This is a state where the state legislature meets once every two years.
sentences.zh: 这是一个州议会每两年才开会一次的州。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: This is a state where most people who ride a motorcycle don't have to wear a helmet.
sentences.zh: 在这个州，大多数骑摩托车的人甚至不需要戴头盔。

sentences.en: And the government doesn't necessarily force them to wear a helmet.
sentences.zh: 政府也不一定会强制他们戴头盔。

sentences.en: It's this idea that you're on your own.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种“一切全靠你自己”的思想。

sentences.en: You want to wear a helmet?
sentences.zh: 你想戴头盔？

sentences.en: Go for it.
sentences.zh: 那就戴吧。

sentences.en: You don't and you get hurt?
sentences.zh: 你不想戴然后受伤了？

sentences.en: Well, okay, it's on you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那得你自己承担。

sentences.en: And especially, you know, during the Obama years, this was happening where Texas sued the government for overreach several times on several different issues.
sentences.zh: 特别是，你知道的，在奥巴马执政时期，德州曾多次就各种不同议题起诉联邦政府过度干预。

sentences.en: I'm joined now by Texas Attorney General Greg Abbott.
sentences.zh: 现在和我连线的是德克萨斯州总检察长格雷格·阿博特。

sentences.en: You've brought suits against the administration some 30 times, correct?
sentences.zh: 您已经对政府提起大约30次诉讼了，对吗？

sentences.en: This is the 31st lawsuit that I brought against the Obama administration, having won more than half of them.
sentences.zh: 这是我对奥巴马政府提起的第31起诉讼，其中我赢了一半以上。

sentences.en: But, Martha, this may be the most serious one because...
sentences.zh: 但是，玛莎，这可能是最严重的一次，因为……

sentences.en: And the attorney general at the time had this famous line where the attorney general says, you know what, my job is very simple.
sentences.zh: 当时的检察长有一句名言，检察长说，你知道吗，我的工作非常简单。

sentences.en: I wake up in the morning, I go to the office, I sue the Obama administration, then I go home.
sentences.zh: 我早上醒来，去办公室，起诉奥巴马政府，然后回家。

sentences.en: If a president can get away with extending his powers to do things like this, there could be no constitutional limitation on what the president could do.
sentences.zh: 如果一个总统可以侥幸扩展权力来做这种事，那么对总统能做什么就不会有宪法层面的限制了。

sentences.en: And so all of that sort of changes or looks a little bit different after Trump takes office.
sentences.zh: 因此，在特朗普上台后，所有这一切都发生了变化，或者说看起来有些不同了。

sentences.en: Now, the Republicans in Texas no longer have that big enemy.
sentences.zh: 现在，德克萨斯州的共和党人不再有那个巨大的敌人了。

sentences.en: And they don't have somebody to go after in their fight over limiting government overreach.
sentences.zh: 在限制政府过度干预的斗争中，他们没有了可以针对的目标。

sentences.en: And so they identify a new enemy.
sentences.zh: 于是他们找到了一个新的敌人。

sentences.en: And that's the Democrats who lead the major cities like San Antonio, Austin, Houston.
sentences.zh: 那就是领导圣安东尼奥、奥斯汀、休斯顿等主要城市的民主党人。

sentences.en: And so this sort of war of words and war of policy begins where the governor and the Republican leadership of Texas has come into the cities and said, San Antonio, you know,
sentences.zh: 因此，这种口水战和政策战开始了，德州州长和共和党领导层介入各个城市，并表示：圣安东尼奥，你知道的，

sentences.en: we want you to cooperate more with the federal authorities on immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你们在移民问题上与联邦当局更多地合作。

sentences.en: Austin, you have a homelessness crisis and we're going to get involved.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀，你们存在无家可归者危机，我们要介入了。

sentences.en: Houston, you have some failing schools and we want to do a state takeover of the public schools in Houston.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿，你们有一些办得不好的学校，我们希望由州政府接管休斯顿的公立学校。

sentences.en: So there's kind of a strange contradiction you're describing here where the Republicans who run the state say they want less government,
sentences.zh: 所以你这里描述了一种奇怪的矛盾：统治该州的共和党人说他们想要更小的政府，

sentences.en: told the Obama administration they want less government.
sentences.zh: 曾对奥巴马政府说他们想要更小的政府。

sentences.en: But now in the era of Trump, they are interfering in the government of their local Democratic cities in a way that may not feel like less government.
sentences.zh: 但现在在特朗普时代，他们却以一种可能不让人觉得是“小政府”的方式，干预他们当地民主党城市的治理。

sentences.en: It's a complete contradiction.
sentences.zh: 这完全是个矛盾。

sentences.en: And that is the situation that's happening as coronavirus hits Texas.
sentences.zh: 而这就是冠状病毒袭击德克萨斯州时正在发生的状况。

sentences.en: And in fact, that attorney general who said how much he loved to sue Obama, well, that attorney general is now the governor, Greg Abbott.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那个曾说自己多么喜欢起诉奥巴马的总检察长，现在成了州长，也就是格雷格·阿博特。

sentences.en: And he's the one who's responsible for the state's response to the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 而他正是负责该州应对新冠疫情的人。

sentences.en: Okay, so given that very complicated stew that you have just described, how does Texas under this governor, Greg Abbott, respond to the virus?
sentences.zh: 好吧，鉴于你刚刚描述的这个非常复杂的局面，在这位州长格雷格·阿博特的领导下，德克萨斯州是如何应对病毒的？

sentences.en: What does his handling of this look like?
sentences.zh: 他对此的处理方式是怎样的？

sentences.en: Overall, you have the governor making some contradictory moves.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，州长采取了一些矛盾的举措。

sentences.en: Starting back in March, you have the coronavirus spreading in the Pacific Northwest and the NortheaSt.
sentences.zh: 早在3月份，冠状病毒就在太平洋西北地区和东北部蔓延。

sentences.en: California is the first state to issue a stay-at-home order.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州是第一个发布居家令的州。

sentences.en: New York follows Ohio.
sentences.zh: 纽约紧随俄亥俄州之后。

sentences.en: But in a lot of other states like Texas, there is no similar move.
sentences.zh: 但在德克萨斯州等许多其他州，并没有采取类似的举措。

sentences.en: And a lot of these states, some of them in the South, don't kind of register the same sort of crisis happening in their own states.
sentences.zh: 其中许多州，尤其是南部的一些州，并没有意识到危机正在它们自己的州内发生。

sentences.en: And then on March 23rd, Lieutenant Governor Patrick agreed to join us tonight.
sentences.zh: 然后在3月23日，副州长帕特里克同意今晚加入我们。

sentences.en: We're happy that he did.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴他能来。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Governor, thanks so much for coming on.
sentences.zh: 副州长，非常感谢您能来。

sentences.en: You have Dan Patrick, who's the lieutenant governor of Texas.
sentences.zh: 丹·帕特里克是德克萨斯州的副州长。

sentences.en: He's Texas's second in command.
sentences.zh: 他是德州仅次于州长的二号人物。

sentences.en: Yeah, I turned 70 next week.
sentences.zh: 对，我下周就70岁了。

sentences.en: You know, so I'm automatically in the high risk pool.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以我自动进入了高风险人群。

sentences.en: Dan Patrick goes on Fox News and basically says...
sentences.zh: 丹·帕特里克上了福克斯新闻，基本上说了这样一番话……

sentences.en: And, you know, Tucker, no one reached out to me and said, as a senior citizen,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，塔克，没有人联系过我并对我说，作为一个老年人，

sentences.en: are you willing to take a chance on your survival in exchange for keeping the America that all America loves for your children and grandchildren?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意为了给你的子孙后代保留全美国都热爱的那个美国，而去冒着生死存亡的风险？

sentences.en: And if that's the exchange, I'm all in.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是交换条件，我全力支持。

sentences.en: He and other grandparents are willing to die to reopen the economy.
sentences.zh: 他和其它祖父母愿意为了重启经济而去死。

sentences.en: And we also have happening is that Abbott around this time is, you know, he's shutting schools.
sentences.zh: 与此同时发生的是，阿博特在大约这个时候，你知道的，他在关闭学校。

sentences.en: He's prohibiting visits to nursing homes.
sentences.zh: 他禁止探访养老院。

sentences.en: He's doing a lot of little things, but not doing that big important one, which is to issue a statewide stay-at-home order.
sentences.zh: 他做了很多小事，但没有做那个最重要的大事，那就是发布全州范围的居家令。

sentences.en: And so, meanwhile, you have the local officials who run a lot of the big cities and counties in Texas saying, okay,
sentences.zh: 所以，与此同时，管理德州许多大城市和县的当地官员说，好吧，

sentences.en: we're going to do this on our own and we're going to enact local policies.
sentences.zh: 我们要靠自己来做这件事，我们要颁布地方政策。

sentences.en: You have the mayors and the officials who run the counties that have Houston and Austin and San Antonio and El Paso all doing different things to try to control the virus.
sentences.zh: 管理休斯顿、奥斯汀、圣安东尼奥和埃尔帕索的市长和官员们都在采取不同的措施来试图控制病毒。

sentences.en: Some of them are issuing curfews.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人发布了宵禁令。

sentences.en: Some of them are issuing local stay-at-home orders.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人发布了地方居家令。

sentences.en: And Abbott is kind of letting all that happen and not really getting involved.
sentences.zh: 而阿博特基本上听任这一切发生，并没有真正介入。

sentences.en: I am also modifying my previous executive order about social distancing protocols in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我也在修改我之前关于德克萨斯州社交距离协议的行政命令。

sentences.en: But then he does get involved.
sentences.zh: 但随后他确实介入了。

sentences.en: I'm issuing executive order GA-14 that establishes or that maximizes the number of lives we can say.
sentences.zh: 我正在发布旨在建立或最大化我们能够拯救的生命数量的GA-14号行政命令。

sentences.en: I'm establishing essential services and activities protocols.
sentences.zh: 我正在制定基本服务和活动协议。

sentences.en: He does eventually issue a statewide stay-at-home order.
sentences.zh: 他最终确实发布了全州范围的居家令。

sentences.en: But he doesn't call it that.
sentences.zh: 但他不这么叫它。

sentences.en: This is not a stay-at-home strategy.
sentences.zh: 这不是一项居家策略。

sentences.en: A stay-at-home strategy would mean that you have to stay at home.
sentences.zh: 居家策略意味着你必须待在家裡。

sentences.en: You cannot leave at home under any circumstances.
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下你都不能离开家。

sentences.en: That obviously is not what we've articulated here.
sentences.zh: 这显然不是我们这里所阐述的内容。

sentences.en: This is a standard.
sentences.zh: 这是一个标准。

sentences.en: And so that leads to a lot of confusion among not just politicians, but just, you know, Texans wondering the very basic question, OK,
sentences.zh: 因此，这不仅在政客中引发了许多困惑，也让普通德州人产生了一个最基本的问题，好吧，

sentences.en: does Texas have a statewide stay-at-home order or not?
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州到底有没有全州的居家令？

sentences.en: And does he ever clarify it?
sentences.zh: 他后来澄清过吗？

sentences.en: He does clarify it.
sentences.zh: 他确实澄清了。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Governor Greg Abbott.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是州长格雷格·阿博特。

sentences.en: With COVID-19 spreading across Texas, I issued this executive order that requires all Texans to stay at home,
sentences.zh: 随着COVID-19在德克萨斯州蔓延，我签署了一项行政命令，要求所有德州人待在家中，

sentences.en: except to provide essential services or do essential things like going to the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 除非是提供基本服务或做去杂货店买东西这样的基本事情。

sentences.en: And it's clear that that was a statewide stay-at-home order.
sentences.zh: 很明显，那是一项全州范围的居家令。

sentences.en: And we will make it through this challenge together.
sentences.zh: 我们将携手度过这一挑战。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And God bless you all.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: And the war between the blue cities and the red state comes up again because Abbott, after issuing the statewide stay-at-home order,
sentences.zh: 蓝色城市与红色州之间的战争再次爆发，因为阿博特在发布全州居家令后，

sentences.en: basically later on tells the cities and the counties, OK, guys, my state orders supersede your local orders.
sentences.zh: 基本上在随后告诉各市和各县，好吧，伙计们，我的州级命令凌驾于你们的地方法令之上。

sentences.en: You can't do anything that's tougher than what I'm doing on coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 在冠状病毒的问题上，你们不能做任何比我更严厉的事情。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And it sort of nullifies and sort of ties the hands of the local officials in doing their own local action on coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上否定并束缚了地方官员在应对新冠病毒时采取自身地方行动的手脚。

sentences.en: So after being very laissez-faire and maybe classically Texas in a hands-off approach,
sentences.zh: 因此，在经历了一段非常自由放任、或许带有经典德州放手不管风格的时期后，

sentences.en: this Republican governor is now telling these cities and counties who acted in his place that his late actions now supersede their earlier solutions.
sentences.zh: 这位共和党州长现在正告诉那些代他行事的城市和县，他迟来的行动现在已经凌驾于他们早先的解决方案之上了。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of confusion, but it has a real effect on people's lives because it has to do, well, it has to do with,
sentences.zh: 这里有很多混乱，但它对人们的生活产生了真正的影响，因为它涉及到，嗯，它涉及到，

sentences.en: can you wear a mask when you're out in public in San Antonio or not?
sentences.zh: 你在圣安东尼奥的公共场所时到底能不能戴口罩？

sentences.en: You know, the locals say, yes, I do have to.
sentences.zh: 当地人说，是的，我必须戴。

sentences.en: Abbott says no.
sentences.zh: 阿博特说不行。

sentences.en: Like, what is going on?
sentences.zh: 这算怎么回事？

sentences.en: You know, like, it has a very real-world impact.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这有着非常现实的影响。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: Shelly Luther is the owner of Salon Alamode.
sentences.zh: 谢莉·路瑟是“阿拉莫德沙龙”的老板。

sentences.en: She arrived here defiantly opening the doors to her salon.
sentences.zh: 她来到这里，公然为她的美发沙龙开门营业。

sentences.en: Another thing happens where a Dallas salon owner is not supposed to open.
sentences.zh: 还发生了另一件事，达拉斯的一位美发沙龙老板本不应该开业。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: She does reopen.
sentences.zh: 她确实重新开业了。

sentences.en: Luther says she fully expects to get arrested today, but she says she has also filed a lawsuit in the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 路瑟说她完全预计自己今天会被捕，但她说她也在最高法院提起了一项诉讼。

sentences.en: And she is sent to jail for reopening.
sentences.zh: 而她因重新开业而被送进监狱。

sentences.en: Right, I remember that she was arrested.
sentences.zh: 对，我记得她被捕了。

sentences.en: We have a disturbing story out of the great state of Texas tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我们从伟大的德克萨斯州听到了一则令人不安的消息。

sentences.en: In Texas, a local salon owner, her name is Shelly Luther.
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州，当地一位美发沙龙的老板，她的名字叫谢莉·路瑟。

sentences.en: And she becomes a conservative celebrity.
sentences.zh: 她成了一个保守派名人。

sentences.en: She was given a seven-day jail sentence, fined $7,000, all because she opened the doors to her business in spite of, quote, local lockdown orders.
sentences.zh: 她被判处七天监禁，罚款7000美元，仅仅因为她在不顾所谓的“地方封锁令”的情况下打开了自己店的大门。

sentences.en: Who was trying to sort of provide for her family by reopening, by restarting the economy, and she's punished and sent to jail for it.
sentences.zh: 她只是试图通过重新开业、重启经济来养家糊口，却因此受到惩罚并被送进监狱。

sentences.en: And the governor does something that, again, frustrates the local officials and fuels this war between the blue cities and the red state.
sentences.zh: 而州长做了一件事，再次让地方官员感到沮丧，并火上浇油地加剧了蓝色城市与红色州之间的这场战争。

sentences.en: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has modified his orders to eliminate confinement as punishment, effectively freeing Shelly Luther.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特修改了他的命令，取消了将拘禁作为惩罚的条款，实际上等同于释放了谢莉·路瑟。

sentences.en: Abbott says, hold on, guys.
sentences.zh: 阿博特说，等等，伙计们。

sentences.en: On my statewide orders, you can't send someone to jail for a violation.
sentences.zh: 根据我的全州命令，你们不能因为违规而把人送进监狱。

sentences.en: Because the uproar among conservatives was so loud and so fierce for that Dallas salon owner, he had to backtrack on that.
sentences.zh: 由于保守派对这位达拉斯沙龙老板的声讨声如此高涨、如此激烈，他不得不收回成命。

sentences.en: So this is becoming a very high-stakes Abbott and Costello kind of routine where the governor is undercutting the cities and the cities are saying this is the rule.
sentences.zh: 因此，这正在演变成一出高风险的“阿博特与科斯特洛”式的滑稽戏：州长削弱了城市，而城市则说这就是规定。

sentences.en: And then the state's saying, no, it's not.
sentences.zh: 然后州政府说，不，才不是。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing that the people of Texas are pretty baffled.
sentences.zh: 我猜德克萨斯州的人民一定感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: When Abbott publicly does an about-face and says, actually, sorry, guys, you can't send someone to jail.
sentences.zh: 当阿博特公开来个一百八十度大转弯，说“其实，抱歉，伙计们，你们不能把人送进监狱”时，

sentences.en: We can't be that tough.
sentences.zh: “我们不能做得那么严厉。”

sentences.en: That moment helped create this atmosphere of almost a little bit of anything goes then, where it's like, what are the rules for coronavirus in Texas?
sentences.zh: 那个时刻营造出了一种几乎有点“百无禁忌”的氛围，就好像是在问：德州关于新冠病毒的规则到底是什么？

sentences.en: What are the penalties?
sentences.zh: 惩罚措施是什么？

sentences.en: What can people do?
sentences.zh: 人们能做什么？

sentences.en: What can't they do?
sentences.zh: 不能做什么？

sentences.en: And how seriously should it be taken?
sentences.zh: 到底该有多认真地对待它？

sentences.en: And does it matter?
sentences.zh: 这重要吗？

sentences.en: And who's going to enforce it?
sentences.zh: 谁来执行？

sentences.en: And, you know, in that moment, Abbott helped Texans let their guard down.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，就在那一刻，阿博特助长了德州人放松警惕的情绪。

sentences.en: And that only increases as the reopening continues.
sentences.zh: 随着重启的继续，这种情绪只会日益高涨。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请在今天下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: My executive order to stay at home that was issued last month is set to expire on April the 30th.
sentences.zh: 我上个月发布的居家令将于4月30日到期。

sentences.en: That executive order has done its job to slow the growth of COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 该居家令已经完成了减缓新冠病毒传播的任务。

sentences.en: And I will let it expire as scheduled.
sentences.zh: 我将让它按计划到期。

sentences.en: Benny, how long does this shutdown in Texas last?
sentences.zh: 本尼，德克萨斯的这次停工持续了多久？

sentences.en: Not very long at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不久。

sentences.en: Texas had one of the shortest shutdowns in the country.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯是全国停工时间最短的州之一。

sentences.en: 28 days.
Now it's time to set a new course.
sentences.zh: 现在是时候制定新的方针了。

sentences.en: A course that responsibly opens up business in Texas.
sentences.zh: 一个负责任地开放德克萨斯商业的方针。

sentences.en: We will open in a way that you...
sentences.zh: 我们将以这样一种方式开放……

sentences.en: And how does Governor Abbott explain having such a short shutdown in the face of a national coronavirus pandemic?
sentences.zh: 面对全国性的冠状病毒大流行，阿博特州长如何解释如此短的停工时间？

sentences.en: His explanation is effectively the coronavirus is bad around the country, but it's not that bad in Texas.
sentences.zh: 他的解释实际上是：全国各地的冠状病毒很严重，但在德克萨斯没那么严重。

sentences.en: More than 1.9 million claims have been filed.
sentences.zh: 已有超过190万份失业索赔被提交。

sentences.en: And over $2 billion has been paid out in unemployment benefits.
sentences.zh: 已发放超过20亿美元的失业救济金。

sentences.en: Now our goal, of course, is to get those Texans back to work.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们现在的目标是让这些德克萨斯人重返工作岗位。

sentences.en: And he doesn't want to hurt the economy more than he needs to.
sentences.zh: 他不想对经济造成不必要的更多伤害。

sentences.en: We are Texans.
sentences.zh: 我们是德克萨斯人。

sentences.en: We got this.
sentences.zh: 我们能行。

sentences.en: So what exactly does the reopening look like?
sentences.zh: 那么重新开放到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: I mean, how quickly does it go from stay-at-home to something that actually looks like a pretty open society again?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从居家令到真正看起来像一个相当开放的社会，这个转变有多快？

sentences.en: You know, almost immediately, the reopening started on May 1St.
sentences.zh: 你知道，几乎是立即开始的，重启从5月1日开始。

sentences.en: I'm in Houston.
sentences.zh: 我在休斯顿。

sentences.en: And I remember driving around Houston on that day.
sentences.zh: 我记得那天开车在休斯顿转悠。

sentences.en: And, you know, I remember being at an intersection.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我记得在一个十字路口。

sentences.en: There were two guys standing with, you know, these signs with big arrows.
sentences.zh: 有两个家伙站在那里，拿着，你知道的，这种带有大箭头的牌子。

sentences.en: And it said, open for dine-in.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：堂食开放。

sentences.en: It was a little bit of a celebratory feel.
sentences.zh: 有点庆祝的气氛。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, you had some Republican conservatives saying, restaurants are open, other businesses, great.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一些共和党保守派说，餐馆开门了，其他企业也开门了，太棒了。

sentences.en: But what about the gyms and the hair salons?
sentences.zh: 但健身房和美发沙龙呢？

sentences.en: Those are still closed.
sentences.zh: 那些仍然关着。

sentences.en: So you had some conservatives saying, great, governor, let's do some more here.
sentences.zh: 所以一些保守派会说，太好了，州长，我们在这多做点吧。

sentences.en: What's wrong?
sentences.zh: 有什么不对吗？

sentences.en: And then meanwhile, you had Democrats, including many local officials, saying, I don't like this.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，民主党人，包括许多地方官员，则表示，我对此很不满。

sentences.en: We have to do it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须这样做。

sentences.en: We have to go along with it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须顺从它。

sentences.en: But we're in a little bit of a risk zone, heading towards a danger zone.
sentences.zh: 但我们正处于一点风险区，正朝着危险区前进。

sentences.en: And once this reopening is well underway, Manny, just how quickly do the infections start to rise?
sentences.zh: 曼尼，一旦这个重新开放全面展开，感染人数开始上升的速度有多快？

sentences.en: It doesn't happen immediately.
sentences.zh: 它不是马上发生的。

sentences.en: You have the numbers going up in May.
sentences.zh: 五月份数字在上升。

sentences.en: But they're going up at sort of a steady but not alarming clip.
sentences.zh: 但它们的上升速度可以说是一个稳定但并不惊人的速度。

sentences.en: And then in the last couple of weeks, as more phases of the reopening have taken effect, as more businesses have reopened, those numbers have hit the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 然后，在过去的几周里，随着重新开放的更多阶段生效，随着更多的企业重新开放，这些数字创下了新高。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你什么意思？

sentences.en: The numbers of new cases skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 新病例数量急剧飙升。

sentences.en: 1,935 as of Monday.
sentences.zh: 截至周一达到1,935例。

sentences.en: The numbers of hospitalizations skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 住院人数急剧飙升。

sentences.en: There was more testing being done, but that didn't account for such a high number so quickly.
sentences.zh: 检测做早了更多，但这并不能解释为什么数字会在这么短时间内变得这么高。

sentences.en: 2,504 new cases.
sentences.zh: 2,504个新病例。

sentences.en: Happening in cities in South Texas, near the border.
sentences.zh: 发生在南德克萨斯州靠近边境的城市里。

sentences.en: 41% increase over the paSt.
sentences.zh: 比过去增长了41%。

sentences.en: In cities in West Texas.
sentences.zh: 在西德克萨斯的城市中。

sentences.en: In cities in the central Texas, in Austin, outside of Austin.
sentences.zh: 在中德克萨斯的城市中，在奥斯汀，在奥斯汀郊外。

sentences.en: More than 4,400 new positive cases.
sentences.zh: 超过4,400例新的阳性病例。

sentences.en: Parts of Waco, Houston area, East Texas.
sentences.zh: 韦科部分地区，休斯顿地区，东德克萨斯。

sentences.en: You have the numbers kind of going up in a lot of different places.
sentences.zh: 你会发现数字在很多不同的地方都在上升。

sentences.en: A lot of different hot spots.
sentences.zh: 许多不同的热点地区。

sentences.en: You had nursing home numbers being very high.
sentences.zh: 养老院的数字非常高。

sentences.en: You also had the numbers of meatpacking plants.
sentences.zh: 肉类加工厂的数字也很高。

sentences.en: Those numbers were very high.
sentences.zh: 这些数字非常高。

sentences.en: So it's clear that this is plain old community transmission.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，这就是最纯粹的社区传播。

sentences.en: Texans infecting other Texans and not social distancing.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯人感染了其他德克萨斯人，而且没有保持社交距离。

sentences.en: A lot of local officials believe that.
sentences.zh: 许多地方官员都是这么认为的。

sentences.en: And a lot of the public health experts believe that.
sentences.zh: 许多公共卫生专家也是这么认为的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They are saying that this uptick is tied to more and more Texans letting their guard down, not wearing a mask, going to restaurants, going out, going to the beaches,
sentences.zh: 他们表示，这种上升与越来越多的德克萨斯人放松警惕、不戴口罩、去餐馆、外出、去海滩有关，

sentences.en: having more gatherings.
sentences.zh: 有了更多的聚会。

sentences.en: And that the reopening is directly tied to the increase in the number of new cases.
sentences.zh: 而重新开放与新病例数量的增加有直接关系。

sentences.en: And so you get to the point where we are now, which is Texas sort of daily breaking records of new cases.
sentences.zh: 所以这就到了我们现在的地步，也就是德克萨斯州的新病例每日都在打破纪录。

sentences.en: And when you say records are being broken, what are the specific numbers?
sentences.zh: 当你说纪录被打破时，具体的数字是多少？

sentences.en: Yesterday, Texas had the most new cases it's had since the pandemic started in a single day.
sentences.zh: 昨天，德克萨斯州迎来了自大流行开始以来单日新增病例最多的一天。

sentences.en: And that was more than 6,200.
sentences.zh: 超过了6,200例。

sentences.en: So there were more than 6,200 new cases in one day yesterday in the state of Texas.
sentences.zh: 所以昨天在德克萨斯州，一天之内就有6,200多起新病例。

sentences.en: And one of the biggest alarm bells that rang was one of the most prominent infectious disease experts and vaccine experts in Texas to a doctor named Dr. Hotez out of Baylor Hospital in Houston.
sentences.zh: 其中一个最大的警报是由德克萨斯州最著名的传染病专家和疫苗专家之一敲响的，他是来自休斯顿贝勒医院的霍特兹医生（Dr. Hotez）。

sentences.en: He put out a tweet over the weekend, and his tweet said that if the numbers in Houston continued to go up the way they were,
sentences.zh: 他在周末发了一条推特，他的推特说，如果休斯顿的数字继续以这种方式上升，

sentences.en: that Houston would be the hardest hit city in America as far as the outbreak goes.
sentences.zh: 就疫情爆发而言，休斯顿将成为美国受打击最严重的城市。

sentences.en: So that brings us to Thursday and the governor's decision to pause this opening.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了周四，以及州长暂停此次开放的决定。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so the governor isn't rolling back the reopening.
sentences.zh: 所以州长并没有收回重新开放的决定。

sentences.en: He's not shutting the state down.
sentences.zh: 他没有关闭全州。

sentences.en: He's just saying from henceforward, we're going to pause any new reopening.
sentences.zh: 他只是说从今以后，我们将暂停任何新的重新开放。

sentences.en: Now, a lot of people have said, well, there's a problem with that.
sentences.zh: 现在，很多人说，好吧，这有个问题。

sentences.en: You know, Texas is basically fully opened right now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，德克萨斯现在基本上已经完全开放了。

sentences.en: Restaurants right now in Texas are allowed to operate at 75% capacity.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯现在的餐馆被允许以75%的容量运营。

sentences.en: And 75% capacity versus 100%, it's not really going to make that much difference.
sentences.zh: 75%的容量和100%相比，其实没有太大区别。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, given the conditions you're describing, it feels like we're basically back to where we were in late March, where the governor of Texas, Greg Abbott,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，鉴于你所描述的情况，感觉我们基本上回到了三月下旬的状态，德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特（Greg Abbott），

sentences.en: for all the reasons that we touched on earlier, is afraid once again to order a shutdown when it is perhaps the best solution to the conditions on the ground.
sentences.zh: 出于我们之前提到的种种原因，再次害怕在或许是应对当地情况的最佳解决方案时下令停工。

sentences.en: And back in March, the question around a shutdown was very urgent because it might have prevented a crisis.
sentences.zh: 早在三月份，关于停工的问题就非常紧迫，因为这本可以阻止一场危机。

sentences.en: Now, Texas is in a crisis and a shutdown would be perhaps required to contain it.
sentences.zh: 现在，德克萨斯州正处于危机之中，而停工或许是控制危机所必需的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's absolutely it.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全是这样。

sentences.en: You know, it's this inherently contradictory dance where he's saying, folks, Texas is open, but stay indoors.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一种本质上矛盾的舞步，他一边说，伙计们，德克萨斯开放了，但请呆在室内。

sentences.en: Texas, you should wear a mask, but I'm not going to order you to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯，你应该戴口罩，但我不会命令你戴口罩。

sentences.en: Texas is open.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯开放了。

sentences.en: From the outside, there is a sense that states like Texas had extra time, at least from the perspective of a place like New York or Seattle.
sentences.zh: 从外部来看，有一种感觉，像德克萨斯这样的州有额外的时间，至少从纽约或西雅图这样地方的角度来看是这样。

sentences.en: They had time to watch and learn from the experiences of the hardest and earliest hit communities in the country and that they should have known that this was going to happen and that what is happening right now in Texas as a result of closing down late and opening early was fairly predictable and yet is now a very serious public health crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们有时间观察并吸取全国受打击最严重和最早受打击的社区的经验，他们本该知道这会发生，而且德克萨斯州由于关闭太晚和开放太早而正在发生的事情是完全可以预见的，然而现在却成了一个非常严重的公共卫生危机。

sentences.en: So what would Governor Abbott say, do you think, to the least charitable version of this question, which is, is there really any excuse for Texas being in this situation right now?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这个问题最苛刻的版本，阿博特州长会怎么说呢？也就是说，德克萨斯州现在处于这种境地，真的有什么借口吗？

sentences.en: I don't know what Governor Abbott would say, but I know that it comes down to worldview and the Texas ideology because it comes down to, you're absolutely right,
sentences.zh: 我不知道阿博特州长会怎么说，但我知道这归结为世界观和德克萨斯州的意识形态，因为归根结底，你说得完全对，

sentences.en: Texas just needing to look around at other states and see what was happening and see the writing on the wall.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯只需要环顾其他州，看看发生了什么，看看墙上的字（大势所趋）。

sentences.en: But Texas didn't want to follow its own path, even in a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但德克萨斯不想走自己的路，哪怕是在大流行期间。

sentences.en: Manny, thank you very much and stay safe.
sentences.zh: 曼尼，非常感谢你，请保持安全。

sentences.en: Thank you so much and thanks for having me on.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，谢谢邀请我参加节目。

sentences.en: On Thursday, based on the results of antibody tests, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said that the number of infections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四，根据抗体检测结果，疾病控制与预防中心表示，美国的感染人数

sentences.en: is probably 10 times higher than has been reported.
sentences.zh: 可能比已报告的高出10倍。

sentences.en: That would mean that so far, about 23 million Americans, or 7% of the population, have been infected.
sentences.zh: 这意味着到目前为止，大约有2300万美国人，即占总人口7%的人被感染了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Supreme Court ruled that immigrants seeking asylum do not have the right to make their case in federal courts,
sentences.zh: 周四，最高法院裁定，寻求庇护的移民无权在联邦法院为自己辩护，

sentences.en: siding with the Trump administration as it seeks to speed up deportations.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府寻求加快驱逐出境的过程中站在了其一边。

sentences.en: The 7-2 ruling upheld a 1996 law passed by Congress that limited the role of federal courts in reviewing rejected claims of asylum.
sentences.zh: 这项7比2的裁决维持了国会于1996年通过的一项法律，该法律限制了联邦法院在审查被拒绝的庇护申请时的作用。

sentences.en: Such a review process, the justices ruled, would overwhelm the nation's immigration system.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定，这样一个审查过程将使国家的移民系统不堪重负。

sentences.en: And amid growing calls for police reforms, officials in three states, Arizona, Colorado, and New York, are confronting cases of alleged brutality by their police officers.
sentences.zh: 在越来越高涨的警察改革呼声中，三个州（亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州和纽约州）的官员正在处理其警员涉嫌暴力的案件。

sentences.en: To demonstrate my willingness to take accountability for these mistakes, I am offering my resignation to the mayor, city council, and city manager,
sentences.zh: 为了表明我愿意为这些错误承担责任，我向市长、市议会和城市经理递交了辞呈，

sentences.en: which they can accept or handle as they deem appropriate.
sentences.zh: 他们可以接受或根据他们认为合适的方式处理。

sentences.en: In Arizona, the chief of police in Tucson offered to resign after releasing a two-month-old video of officers restraining a 27-year-old Latino man, Carlos Ingram Lopez,
sentences.zh: 在亚利桑那州，图森市警察局长在公布了一段两个月前的视频后提出辞职，视频显示警察将一名27岁的拉丁裔男子卡洛斯·英格拉姆·洛佩斯（Carlos Ingram Lopez）

sentences.en: face down on the ground for 12 minutes, resulting in his death.

sentences.en: In Colorado, the governor appointed a special prosecutor to investigate the death of a 23-year-old black man, Elijah McLean,
sentences.zh: 在科罗拉多州，州长任命了一名特别检察官来调查23岁黑人男子伊利亚·麦克莱恩（Elijah McLean）的死因，

sentences.en: who died after officers stopped him in the street and put him in a chokehold.
sentences.zh: 他在警察将其在街上拦下并对其进行锁喉后死亡。

sentences.en: And in New York, an officer was arrested after being caught on tape Sunday using a chokehold, which is now banned in the state, to subdue a 35-year-old black man, Ricky Bellevue.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，一名警察在周日被拍到使用现在在该州已被禁用的锁喉动作来制服一名35岁的黑人男子里奇·贝尔维尤（Ricky Bellevue）后被捕。
